registry.item_title: Participants With Any Major Bleeding Event

item_title_witness.text: Participants With Any Major Bleeding Event

notes: Selected the primary overall major bleeding outcome, adjudicated using the study protocol scale; safety analysis set (randomized patients who took at least one dose), first dosing up to 12 months. Other registry bleeding outcomes: Participants With Non-CABG (Coronary Artery Bypass Graft) Related Major Bleeding; Participants With Major or Minor Bleeding; Participants With Non-procedural Major Bleeding; Participants With Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) Major Bleeding; Participants With Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) Major Fatal/Life-threatening Bleeding. The held CT.gov results extract repeats these outcome measures. The abstract reports overall major bleeding and non-CABG major bleeding as percentages, not event counts; no percentage conversion was used.
